1.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: signed "Le B[ar]on d[e] Mohrenheim" under the letterhead "Royaume de Pologne. Affaires Étrangères"; addressed at the foot "À Mr. Schmidt, Consul Général de Prusse"

10.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: a copy, "signé Engel"; addressed at the foot of the scan "A Mr. Schmidt, Consul G. de Prusse"

11.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: signed on the scan with the same signature as document 9, "R. Fuhrmann" (not transcribed); addressed at the foot "à Mr. Schmidt Cser. Pé. de légation Csul. Gal. de Sa Majesté le Roi de Prusse"

2.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: a note signed with the initial M and the flourish of Mohrenheim's full signature (documents 1 and 4); it addresses "mon cher Schmidt"

3.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: a note signed "L. B. d. Mohrenheim", read on the scan; it opens "Mon cher Schmidt"

4.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: signed "Mohrenheim", same letterhead and number as document 1; addressed at the foot of the scan to "Mr. Schmidt, Consul Gal. de Prusse" (the address is not transcribed)

5.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: addressed "Monsieur le Consul" and, at the foot of the scan, to "Mr. Schmidt Consul Gal. de S. M. le Roi de Prusse". The short signature under a heavy stroke is not read. The writer passes Schmidt's notes on to the "Prince Ministre des finances" (Lubecki) and speaks for "l'administration Polonaise", so he is not Lubecki; the sender is left open

6.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: a copy, "sig. X. X. Lubecki", headed "Minister Prezydujący w Kom. Rząd. Przychodów i Skarbu"; it answers the addressee's claim for the mortgage of 30,000 thalers struck off Trąbczyn, which is Weigel's, and document 7 is his reply

7.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: headed "Abschrift meiner Antwort an den Schatzminister des Königreichs Polen, Herrn Fürsten v. Lubecki", unsigned; the writer's claim of 63,100 thalers and the entry "pro v. Grottowski modo für mich" are Weigel's (document 6; III. HA MdA, III. Nr. 12366)

8.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: a copy, "sig. X. X. Lubecki", same heading as document 6; it answers the addressee's letter of 14 October 1830, document 7

9.basis: ruling 2026-10-04: signed on the scan "R. Fuhrmann" (the signature is not transcribed); addressed at the foot of the first page "A Monsieur le Conseiller Privé de Legation Schmidt Consul General de Sa Majesté le Roi de Prusse dans le Royaume de Pologne".
